<?php
class CopyA66 { public function __destruct() { echo 'A-DROP|'; } }
class CopyB66 { public function __destruct() { echo 'B-DROP|'; } }
function Make66Copy() {
    global $weakGiven;
    $value = new Exception('given66');
    $weakGiven = WeakReference::create($value);
    return $value;
}
function Run66Copy() {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $value = $g->throw(Make66Copy());
    echo 'VALUE|', (int) ($value === 7), '|';
    return 'fiber66';
}
$cell = 5;
$old =& $cell;
$source = new CopyA66();
$weakA = WeakReference::create($source);
$factory = function &(&$item) use ($source) {
    global $weakGiven;
    try {
        echo 'SEED|';
        yield $item;
        echo 'BAD-TAIL|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'CAUGHT|', (int) ($caught === $weakGiven->get()), '|';
        Fiber::suspend('pause66');
        echo 'CAPTURE|', (int) ($source instanceof CopyA66), '|';
        yield $item;
        echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    }
    return 66;
};
$weakClosure = WeakReference::create($factory);
$g = $factory($cell);
unset($factory);
echo 'PRIME|', (int) ($g->current() === 5), '|';
$f = new Fiber('Run66Copy');
echo 'START|', (int) ($f->start() === 'pause66'), '|';
$replacement = 9;
$cell =& $replacement;
$old = 7;
$source = new CopyB66();
$weakB = WeakReference::create($source);
echo 'PARK|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|',
     (int) ($g->current() === 7), '|',
     (int) ($cell === 9), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() !== null), '|';
try {
    $g->next();
    echo 'BAD-REENTRY|';
} catch (Error $error) {
    echo 'ERROR|', (int) ($error->getMessage() === 'Cannot resume an already running generator'),
         '|', (int) ($error->getPrevious() === null), '|';
}
echo 'RESUME|', (int) ($f->resume() === null), '|';
echo 'FIBER|', (int) ($f->getReturn() === 'fiber66'), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) ($g->getReturn() === 66), '|',
     (int) ($weakA->get() !== null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() !== null), '|';
unset($source);
echo 'B|', (int) ($weakB->get() === null), '|';
unset($g, $f, $cell, $old, $replacement, $error);
echo 'DROP|', (int) ($weakA->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakClosure->get() === null), '|',
     (int) ($weakGiven->get() === null), '|';
unset($weakA, $weakB, $weakClosure, $weakGiven);
